title: Creator Pack / Narrative Inspector & Dependency Graph
objective: Resume the interrupted CNI family after the completed MAS interstitial by providing deterministic developer/creator inspection surfaces for manifests, component selection, dependency graphs, condition explanations, scoped state references, dialogue/trigger links, localization coverage, patch conflicts and provenance without becoming public sharing, marketplace or canonical owner-state authority.

scope.purpose: Provide creator/developer inspection and debugging projections over the completed CNI-01..11 content/narrative interoperability foundations without creating a second content runtime, canonical state store, sharing system or marketplace.
scope.completion_gate: A representative creator/developer inspection workspace can deterministically explain and traverse explicit CNI manifest/component/dependency/condition/state/dialogue/trigger/localization/conflict/provenance references, fails closed on invalid or unauthorized references, preserves visibility and owner-domain boundaries, and does not mutate canonical state or imply public sharing/marketplace authority.

selection_boundaries: Owner Continue on 2026-09-16 governed-started CNI-12; implementation authority is limited to work/cni-12-creator-pack-narrative-inspector-dependency-graph.
CNI-01 through CNI-11 and MAS-01 through MAS-21 remain completed foundations and must not be reopened silently.

Validation Core deliberately transitions from MAS back to CNI at this governed start. The transition seals the completed MAS-21 application merge as predecessor baseline, restores the CNI profile prefix, retires MAS automatic validation authority, and does not rerun historical MAS profiles.
Detailed inspector/visibility/provenance owner seams must be resolved by targeted dependency loading from live CNI contracts rather than broad historical rereads.

CNI-12 is an authoring/debugging projection only: it does not create a second content runtime, canonical state store, sharing/distribution system, marketplace, rights registry, provenance authority or owner-domain mutation path.
CNI-13 retains Golden Multi-Pack Narrative Compatibility Proof scope and must not be pulled forward.
PCA remains eligible where its own milestone gates are satisfied but remains unselected; MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized until a later OPS3 selection.
next_action: Transition Validation Core from MAS back to CNI on the named application branch, load only direct CNI-01..11 inspector seams, establish causal RED, then implement the minimum deterministic non-mutating creator/debug inspector projection.
